coder_notes: Peptide cancer vaccine trial (TERT and PTPRZ1 epitopes on synthetic melanin) with litenimod TLR9 agonist adjuvant, on standard adjuvant temozolomide. Only one registered intervention ('Biological: immunization'); agents split per description. IDH row: IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma is an exclusion criterion (IDH-wildtype used to define GBM), hence cns5. PTPRZ1 expression is an entry requirement for Phase 1 only (enrichment); it matches the A49-Mel vaccine target but the vaccine is not a candidate. HLA-A2 positivity (Phase 1) not recorded as germline/immune marker. Ancillary study mentions checkpoint expression on relapse tumour cells; not recorded as a defined biomarker. T-cell response endpoints are vaccine immunogenicity, not target engagement of a candidate.
